performance_case.causal_mechanism: A task-bound, fail-closed Local handoff pipeline that accepts the current sealed Server Canonical diagnostic identity can avoid discarding a completed fourteen-day forward slice after a lawful pre-outcome restart.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may establish only static pipeline binding readiness and a bounded implementation closure. It cannot access forward outcomes or establish prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any market drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a later preregistered matched-capital strategy experiment passes independent gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Leaving the superseded fixed local identity in executable code can waste the current fourteen-day collection and delay a strategy decision by at least another untouched evidence window; an over-broad correction could weaken identity and path integrity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The correction cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but eliminating a deterministic post-collection handoff mismatch shortens time to a credible accept-or-reject decision without increasing candidate count or relaxing scientific gates.
